text: 你转身折返舞厅入口。门边那名警官吸引了你的注意，让你挪不开眼。他气势逼人，目光锐利地盯着你，看着你朝他走去。
你走近到能听清他说话的距离时，他把手搭在警棍上，清了清嗓子。“我真希望今晚不会出什么乱子，公民。我可不想看到有人受伤。”他的手始终没有离开警棍。

en.title: Alone Against the Tide · 88
text: You turn around and backtrack toward the entrance to the ballroom. Something about the officer by the door catches your attention and holds it. He gives off a commanding presence and his eyes bore into you intensely as you make your way over to him.

As you move within earshot, he rests his hand on his baton and clears his throat. “I really hope there isn’t going to be any sort of problem, citizen. I wouldn’t want to see anyone getting hurt tonight.” His hand does not move from his baton.
